evals.prompt: 使用 tta-tone 成稿。材料：8 月 13 日晚上我还在 Cursor 池子里猛蹬，看到官方把 V4 Pro 挂出来，又撞上 GLM-5.3 对狙。咸鱼上吃灰的老 Lite 突然有了用处，我就把 ZCode 下下来看成色。它帮我把两个开源项目交叉的顽固 bug 跑通了，纯文本模型也跑了将近一个小时。请写成一篇给小园丁看的经验稿开头加两节，不要发明材料里没有的项目细节。
evals.expected_output: A draft that keeps the personal timeline and the working example, then invites readers in. It must not rewrite the opening into a report skeleton.
expectations: opening keeps a first-person timeline (a date or that night, what the author was using)
a concrete working example appears before the inventory of modules
does not rewrite the opening into 本文将介绍 or 五大模块 report skeleton
does not open with 我在写这篇 or 今天打开草稿
does not invent project names or numbers absent from the prompt

evals.prompt: 使用 tta-tone。下面是我准备写进博客的现场，先分析，先不要优化，也不要出正文。8 月 13 日晚上看到 V4 Pro 挂出来，我把 ZCode 下下来，它跑了将近一个小时修完两个开源项目交叉 bug。
evals.expected_output: An analysis of the on-site grid only. No drafted article body.
expectations: stops at analysis of the on-site grid (当时 / 例子 / 心得 / 货 / 原句 or equivalent)
does not output a full blog draft or rewritten opening
does not start polishing sentences into publishable prose

evals.prompt: 使用 tta-tone 成稿。这是上下文，不是让你改成这样：上周我用 ZCode 修 Velaterm 交叉 bug，跑了 50 多分钟。正文要写的是 ZCode 的 Harness 五块怎么配，不要把修 bug 那件事写成开篇主戏。
evals.expected_output: A draft about the Harness inventory. The bug-fix story stays context, not the opening set piece.
expectations: the requested subject is Harness configuration, not a bug-fix narrative as the main opening
the Velaterm / 50-minute example is not promoted into the opening set piece
does not say it is rewriting the user's context into the house style

evals.prompt: 使用 tta-tone 把这段收成公开稿小节标题和一段正文：说人话版本——我踩过的坑。内容是项目级 Hooks 配了也不执行，只能走用户级。
evals.expected_output: A public-facing section that states the Hooks limitation without the banned labels.
expectations: public copy does not use 说人话版 or 说人话版本 as a title or label
public copy does not use 我踩过的坑 as a title or label
the Hooks limitation (project-level does not run; use user-level) is still stated

evals.prompt: 使用 tta-tone 默认语气。刚才已经把成稿基调改完了，用对话回我这一则：现在默认成稿跟哪份金样本，经验稿缺现场格子时能不能编。
evals.expected_output: A dialogue reply with embedded kaomoji+emoji mix, a now/before table, and a muttering quote. Not a reader-facing article.
expectations: names canon.md or the ZCode vault sample as the draft canon
says an empty on-site grid must be asked or marked empty, not invented
dialogue reply includes a now/before table
dialogue reply includes a muttering quote block under the table
a ready-made kaomoji+emoji mix appears in the dialogue turn, not only as a trailing sticker
